blogs.title: Beyond LoRA: Introducing a Smarter Way to Fine-Tune Giant AI Models
blogs.description: An introductory guide to Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT). This post explains the evolution from standard fine-tuning to LoRA and finally to Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT), highlighting how BOFT balances the need for low parameter counts with the power to adapt massive models without losing their original knowledge.

blogs.title: The Butterfly Effect: How FFT Logic is Revolutionizing AI Training
blogs.description: A deep dive into the 'secret sauce' of BOFT. This post explores the inspiration drawn from the Cooley-Tukey Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and explains how 'butterfly structures' and information transmission graphs allow us to create dense, powerful matrices using only a fraction of the parameters.

blogs.title: One Framework, Many Worlds: BOFT's Versatility Across LLMs, Vision, and Diffusion
blogs.description: A showcase of BOFT's flexibility. This post discusses the empirical results of the research, demonstrating how a single orthogonal finetuning approach can effectively adapt everything from Large Language Models (LLMs) to Vision Transformers and Text-to-Image diffusion models like Stable Diffusion.

blogs.title: The Geometry of Knowledge: Why Orthogonality Matters in AI
blogs.description: A conceptual look at the mathematics of BOFT. This post explains the importance of preserving the 'angles between neurons' and spectral norms, illustrating why keeping a model's internal geometric structure intact leads to more stable training and better generalization compared to traditional methods.
